data.narrative:
Darkhive, a Series A defense and security company founded by Steve Turner, has raised $22M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 same-sector peers at Series A and Series B stages, comprising 8 private companies and 2 public entities (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). Key private comparables include Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Singularity, and NODA AI, with peer valuations ranging from $125M to $3.0B.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method, using the $22M raised as a proxy baseline and applying a typical 2.0x Series A step-up multiplier, implies a valuation of $44M. The peer-median approach across the 10-company Defense & Security cohort yields a median valuation of $1.0B, with the peer set distributed between $125M and $3.0B. These methods produce a weighted triangulated range of $37M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $522M.

The wide range reflects material uncertainty around Darkhive's relative position within a heterogeneous peer cohort spanning early-stage and later-stage companies. Stage-progression suggests a floor near $37M, while peer comparables support a substantially higher valuation, though the $1.0B+ level depends critically on product-market validation and near-term revenue trajectory relative to later-stage peers. Additional clarity on revenue, customer concentration, and time-to-Series B would narrow the band.
